correctness.rationale: A four-stage complete integer proof: (1) derive H(k)=gcd(F_{k+1}-1,F_{k+2}-1) by the Fibonacci unimodular matrix identity; (2) use Cassini norm and all cubic root pairs modulo primes not three, and 3-adic lifting, to show A(k)=3^[8|k]H(k); (3) prove gcd of every adjacent window difference is exactly A(k), using shift recurrence and 3h divisibility; (4) an exact telescoping cubic identity gives A|2S_0 and a sharp 2-adic expansion for 6|k gives gcd(A,S_0)=A/2, versus A otherwise. Boundary k=2 and simultaneous 6|k,8|k included. Reproducibility script independently checks 200 even lengths and 6,200 exact window differences, but is not used to justify infinity.

originality.rationale: The primary article arXiv:2204.12626 Section 6.1 explicitly poses a cubic-window gcd formula as a conjecture, and its stated factor-one-half location is opposite the proved one. Direct counterexamples at lengths 6 and 8 disprove that stated case split. The complete repaired all-even-length formula is not implied by the first-power theorem of arXiv:2104.12262; it needs the cubic root, three-adic and two-adic arguments. No dominating statement was found in inspected primary texts, the first-power OEIS entry, and targeted indexed and bibliographic comparisons. This establishes originality relative to the inspected evidence only.
residual_risks: The reversed printed congruence conditions might originate in a typographical error, not an intended proven claim.
A subsequent or unindexed paper may independently derive the corrected cubic gcd formula.
Odd windows and Lucas cubes were not investigated as consequences of the theorem.

value.rationale: The result supplies a complete corrected theorem for the explicit unproved 2022 Question 6.1 on cubic Fibonacci windows, including all even k and exact valuation mechanisms at divisibility by 6 and 8. The published case split fails at two small but meaningful examples, and the complete proof is substantially stronger than a numerical correction, fitting the known first-power gcd structure and giving a sharp 3-adic extension.
